integrity: The mathematical proof supplies an all-dimensional derivation and the exact-arithmetic verifier is a finite consistency check. No independent verification, priority certification or claim of authorship is made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only consecutive cardinality intervals and the unweighted one-skeleton. It is proved analytically, with finite computation used only as a check; equivalent older alias-named spectral literature cannot be categorically ruled out.
title: Exact Laplacian factorization and paired harmonics of consecutive-layer hypersimplex graphs
